therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: HER2 antibody-drug conjugate therapy combined with HER2 kinase inhibition and antimetabolite chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: HER2-driven tumor cell proliferation and survival

results.dose_information: Margetuximab 15 mg/kg IV on Day 1 of each cycle; Tucatinib 300 mg orally twice daily continuously in 21-day cycles; Capecitabine 1000 mg/m2 orally twice daily on days 1-14 of each 21-day cycle

context.investigator_commentary: Funder decided to not continue the study
